scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ai-layout/web test && uv run --directory apps/server pytest -q
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ai-layout/web typecheck && uv run --directory apps/server mypy app
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @ai-layout/web lint && uv run --directory apps/server ruff check .
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @ai-layout/web format && uv run --directory apps/server ruff format .
scripts.contracts:gen: pnpm contracts:export && orval --config orval.config.ts && json2ts -i packages/contracts/generated/ws.schema.json -o apps/web/src/contracts/generated/ws.d.ts
